name: wait
description: 等待工具（同步阻塞）。三种用法：1) 纯时间：time.duration 支持 1500ms / 30s / 5min（最小 100ms），或 time.until 支持 ISO 8601 或本地 HH:mm / HH:mm:ss；2) 纯条件：conditions 等待会话/任务运行结束（session）、终端命令执行结束（terminal）、指定工具调用结束（tool）、智能体运行结束（agent，用于 async 子代理），match=all 全部满足 / any 任一满足；3) 时间+条件：两者都满足才返回，到达时间点仍未满足时正常返回并标记 timedOut（不报错）。单次等待硬上限 30 分钟（超限直接报错，请拆分多次）。条件目标启动时校验：不存在直接报错，目标已结束视为已满足。禁止等待当前会话自身或当前工具调用自身（会死锁，直接报错）。终端忙闲只统计经 run() 执行的命令，用户在终端手工输入的命令无法观测。等待期间可被用户停止（返回 aborted）。
description_en: Wait tool (synchronous blocking). Three usages: 1) time only: time.duration accepts 1500ms / 30s / 5min (min 100ms), or time.until accepts ISO 8601 or local HH:mm / HH:mm:ss; 2) conditions only: wait for a session/task to finish (session), a terminal command to finish (terminal), a specific tool call to finish (tool), or an agent to finish (agent, for async subagents); match=all requires every condition, any requires one; 3) time + conditions: returns only when both are satisfied; if the time point is reached while conditions are still pending it returns normally with timedOut=true (not an error). Hard cap 30 minutes per wait (larger values are rejected; split into multiple waits). Targets are validated at start: a missing target is an error, an already-finished target counts as satisfied. Waiting for the current session or the current tool call itself is rejected (deadlock). Terminal busy only tracks commands executed via run(); manually typed commands are not observable. The wait can be stopped by the user (returns aborted).

time.description: 时间条件。duration 与 until 互斥；与 conditions 同时提供时，两者都满足才返回。
time.description_en: Time condition. duration and until are mutually exclusive; when combined with conditions, both must be satisfied before returning.

until.description: 等待到的时刻：ISO 8601（可带时区）或本地 HH:mm / HH:mm:ss；纯时刻取下一次（今天已过则为明天）；早于当前时间视为已到达。
until.description_en: Wait until an instant: ISO 8601 (timezone optional) or local HH:mm / HH:mm:ss; a bare time means the next occurrence (tomorrow if already past today); a past instant counts as already reached.

conditions.description: 状态条件（最多 16 个）：session=会话/任务结束；terminal=终端命令结束；tool=指定工具调用结束；agent=智能体运行结束（async 子代理，按 agentId 或 sessionId）。
conditions.description_en: State conditions (max 16): session = session/task finished; terminal = terminal command finished; tool = specific tool call finished; agent = agent run finished (async subagent, by agentId or sessionId).

sessionId.description: 目标会话/任务 id（kind=session 时必填；kind=tool 与 kind=terminal 缺省为当前会话；kind=agent 可与 agentId 二选一）。
sessionId.description_en: Target session/task id (required for kind=session; defaults to the current session for kind=tool and kind=terminal; optional for kind=agent when agentId is given).

terminalId.description: 目标终端 id（kind=terminal 可选；缺省用 sessionId 的默认终端）。
terminalId.description_en: Target terminal id (optional for kind=terminal; defaults to the default terminal of sessionId).

toolCallId.description: 目标工具调用 id（kind=tool 时必填）。
toolCallId.description_en: Target tool call id (required for kind=tool).

agentId.description: 目标智能体短 id（kind=agent，如 a1 / a2 / main；可用 agent_status list 查看）。与 sessionId 至少提供一个。
agentId.description_en: Target agent short id (kind=agent, e.g. a1 / a2 / main; see agent_status list). Provide at least one of agentId and sessionId.

match.description: 条件组合方式：all=全部满足（默认），any=任一满足；时间条件始终需要到达。
match.description_en: Condition combination: all = every condition (default), any = at least one; the time condition must always be reached.

quiet.description: true 时不发送等待进度事件（默认 false，每 10 秒最多一次）。
quiet.description_en: When true, no progress events are emitted (default false, at most once every 10 seconds).
